column1: # SPEC-08: the checklist's rows for markup compatibility, written by hand, since ECMA-376 Part 3 ships
# no XSD. The generator adds these to docs/spec under area MCE, and keeps their status columns like
# any other row. Tied to BEH-18 (docs/51). What each does: crates/casual-slide-ooxml/src/mce.rs.
# Columns, tab-separated: owner, kind, name, type, use, restriction.

column6: Part 3 9.1. Takes the first Choice whose Requires are understood, else Fallback. Both branches stay in the part
The first that applies is taken. At least one, before any Fallback
Taken when no Choice applies. At most one, and last
Every prefix must be declared, and must name a namespace this engine understands
Namespaces a consumer not understanding them may skip. Scoped to the element and its descendants
Ignorable elements whose content is kept and processed. Must name an ignorable namespace
